source: 622 Smell of Death
target: 622 Odor Mortis

source: Under normal circumstances, dark-gray eyes wouldn’t usually grab one’s attention.
target: Sub condicionibus ordinariis, oculi cinerei obscuri non solent animos hominum capere.

source: Such pupils were rare in Intis but not uncommon in places like the Loen Kingdom.
target: Talia oculi Intis rara erant, sed in locis ut Regnum Loen non erant insolitae.

source: However, Franca sensed that there was crucial information hidden within.
target: Attamen, Franca sensit informationem maximi momenti abditam intus esse.

source: Moran Avigny was suspected to be a Mirror Person.
target: Moran Avigny suspicabatur esse persona speculi.

source: The Demoness of Black Clarice pursued the Mirror People, and being a demigod of the Demoness pathway closely related to the Mirror World, they all shared those unusual dark gray eyes.
target: Demonia Nigrae Clarice personas speculi persequebatur, et, cum semideus per viam Demonii, prope Mundi Speculorum conexus esset, omnes illos oculos cinerei obscuri insolitos habebant.

source: Too much of a coincidence, isn’t it?
target: Nimis fortuita res, nonne?

source: “What’s wrong?” Jenna asked with concern when Franca paused.
target: “Quid accidit?” Jenna sollicite rogavit, cum Franca cessavit.

source: Franca deliberated for a few seconds before revealing that the Demoness of Black shared the same eye color as Moran Avigny.
target: Franca per paucos secundos deliberavit antequam enuntiavit Demoniam Nigrae eundem colorem oculorum cum Moran Avigny habere.

source: Finally, she said, “None of the Mirror People we encountered previously had such characteristics.”
target: Postremo, dixit: “Nemo ex personis speculi, quas antea conveneramus, talia attributa habuit.”

source: “Only relatively special Mirror People have them? Is the Demoness of Black also a Mirror Person?” Jenna guessed, her thoughts wandering.
target: “Num solum personae speculi praecipuae ea habent? Num et Demoniam Nigrae persona speculi est?” Jenna coniectavit, mentibus vagantibus.

source: “Impossible,” Franca subconsciously denied. “She even tasked me with investigating the Mirror People… Right, it’s not impossible. Haven’t we read enough stories of burglars calling the police to catch thieves?”
target: "Impossibile," Franca subconscie negavit. "Ipsa etiam mihi mandavit investigare personas speculi… Recte, non est impossibile. Nonne satis fabulas legimus de latronibus, qui vigilibus vocant ad fures capiendos?"

source: Anthony thought for a moment and said, “Could it be a symbol of being corrupted by the mirror’s Primordial Demoness? Could special Mirror People at a certain level have such eye color? Could it be the same for a Demoness who has become a demigod and has been corrupted?
target: "Antonius paulisper cogitavit et dixit, 'Num hoc sit signum corruptionis a Demoniae Primordiali speculi? Num aliquae personae speculi peculiares, ad aliquod gradum, talem colorem oculorum habere possint? Num idem contingat Demoniae, quae semideus facta et corrupta est?'"

source: “No, Moran Avigny should have had dark gray eyes to begin with. It’s impossible for the Mirror People who replaced him to change the color of his eyes without attracting suspicion,” Franca pondered and deduced, “In other words, does the Demoness of Black come from the same family as the original Moran Avigny? I previously thought she belonged to the Sauron family and was Browns Sauron’s elder. Otherwise, she wouldn’t have nurtured such a simple-minded Demoness. Now, it doesn’t seem so…”
target: "Non, Moran Avigny debuit a principio oculos cinerei obscuri habuisse. Impossibile est ut personis speculi, quae eum substituerunt, colorem oculorum eius mutaverint sine suspicione excitanda," Franca meditata et deduxit, "Aliter, num Demoniam Nigrae eadem familia originaria Moran Avigny proveniat? Olim putavi eam ad familiam Sauron pertinere et majorem fuisse quam Browns Sauron. Aliter, non talem insipientem Demoniam educasset. Nunc hoc sic videri non videtur..."

source: “Not necessarily,” Franca and Jenna said in unison.
target: "Non necessario," Franca et Jenna simul dixerunt.

source: Everyone had a paternal and maternal side of the family.
target: Omnes partes familiares paternae et maternales habebant.

source: Just because they were from the Sauron family didn’t mean they weren’t from a dark-gray-eyed family!
target: Etenim ex familia Sauron esse, non significat eos non esse ex familia oculis cinerei obscuri!

source: Franca hesitated for a few seconds before saying, “It’s been a while since I updated the Demoness of Black on the Mirror People investigation. I plan to visit her this week and discuss Moran Avigny.”
target: Franca paucos secundos dubitavit antequam dixit: “Iamdiu non renovavi Demoniam Nigrae de indagatione personarum speculi. Illam hac hebdomade visitare constitutus sum et de Moran Avigny disserere.”

source: “Be careful,” Jenna cautioned.
target: “Cave,” Jenna monuit.

source: A gleaming smile played on Franca’s lips as she replied, “Don’t worry. She tasked me with the Mirror People inquiry, so she should anticipate some updates. If she has ties with Moran Avigny, we might see something unfolding for the Minister of Industry shortly. If not, we can seek her assistance!”
target: Splendidus risus in labiis Francae ludos habebatur, dum respondebat: “Noli solliciti esse. Ipsa mihi mandavit de indagatione personarum speculi, itaque novitates aliquas se praeparare debet. Si vincula cum Moran Avigny habet, fortasse mox aliquid de Ministro Industriae eveniet. Alioquin, eius auxilium quaerere poterimus!”

source: On Hanth Island, Lumian strolled through the dimly lit streets, relishing the cool sea breeze that replaced the earlier heat as he casually headed back to the Berries.
target: In insula Hanth, Lumian per vias tenuiter illuminatas ambulabat, fruens frigida aura maris quae priorem calorem substituit, dum comiter ad Berries redibat.

source: Hands tucked into his pockets, his mind raced with unusual activity.
target: Manus in sinu reclusae, mens eius cum inusitata activitate cursabat.

source: He sifted through the legends and stories he had recently gathered, attempting to uncover any hints about the elusive Demon.
target: Legendas et fabulas nuper collectas perlegit, conatus ut ullos indicios de daemon effugientis detegeret.

source: Had Madam Magician not issued a cautious warning, and had Naboredisley not disclosed the Demon descendant’s name and identity, Lumian might have considered using himself as bait.
target: Nisi Magistra Magica cautum monitum edixisset, et Naboredisley nomen atque identitatem daemonis progeniei non revelavisset, Lumian fortasse se tamquam escam adhibere cogitavisset.

source: In such circumstances, he could have showcased his malice, devised a plan with a chance of success, triggering the Demon’s Danger Premonition, luring it out to eliminate the perceived threat.
target: His condicionibus, potuisset malitiam suam ostendere, consilium cum aliqua spe successus excogitare, praemonitionem periculorum daemonis excitare, eum allicere ut minationem perceptam supprimeret.

source: A concealed trap would await it.
target: Insidiae celatae illi exspectarent.

source: It’s been a century or two.
target: Iam unum vel duo saecula praeterierunt.

source: Numerous adventurers have ventured to unravel the Demon legend.
target: Multi viatores ausi sunt daemonis fabulam resolvere.

source: Despite the Church of Earth Mother’s relentless efforts to eradicate lingering issues, there’s still no resolution.
target: Non obstante indefessis conatibus Ecclesiae Matris Terræ ad removendas quaestiones moras, adhuc solutio non invenitur.

source: Relying on conventional methods to track down that elusive Demon seems impractical…
target: Confidens in modis conventionalibus daemonem effugientem deprehendere, id prorsus inefficax videtur…

source: Looking at it from a different angle, why would the Demon choose to remain on Hanth Island?
target: Ex angulo alio spectato, cur daemon vellet in insula Hanth manere?

source: The Church of Earth Mother already purged it once.
target: Ecclesia Matris Terræ eam iam semel purgavit.

source: Why take the risk to stay?
target: Cur periclitari manendo?

source: If it were me, I would have relocated ages ago.
target: Si ego essem, olim me translocavissem.

source: As a Demon, where couldn’t I survive?
target: Ut daemon, ubi non possum superesse?

source: If I truly believed I was a highly intelligent criminal—a genuine Criminal—why use such a method to taunt the clergy of the Church of Earth Mother? It would become dull after all these years…
target: Si vere crederem me esse scelestum ingenio praestantem—verum scelestum—cur talem modum ad irridendum clerum Ecclesiae Matris Terræ adhiberem? Id post tantos annos tediosum factum esset…

source: Could there be a reason for its persistence on Hanth Island?
target: Num aliqua causa sit pro eius perseverantia in insula Hanth?

source: Is it perhaps partially sealed? Or is there something profoundly significant buried on the island that cannot be moved?
target: Num fortasse partim clausum sit? An aliquid prorsus grave in insula sepultum sit, quod moveri non possit?

source: The valley ablaze with sulfurous flames?
target: Vallis sulphureis flammarum incensa?

source: Moreover, Demons can live for centuries, but ordinary people cannot.
target: Praeterea, daemones per saecula vivere possunt, sed homines ordinarii non possunt.

source: If the Demon indeed concealed itself in human towns, it would have to change identities every few decades, potentially leaving traces.
target: Si daemon vere se in urbibus humanis celaverit, identitatem singulis decadiis mutare oporteret, fortasse vestigia relinquens.

source: Hanth Island serves as a transit port for trade routes between the Northern and Southern Continents.
target: Insula Hanth ad portum transitus servit semitis commercii inter Continentes Septentrionales et Meridionales.

source: With numerous foreign settlers, the Demon can effortlessly forge a new identity.
target: Cum multis colonis externis, daemon facile novam identitatem fingere potest.

source: However, how can it smoothly exit the stage with its original identity?
target: Sed quomodo leniter exire potest cum sua identitate originali?

source: The residents here all devoutly follow Earth Mother.
target: Incolae hic omnes devotissime Matrem Terræ sequuntur.

source: Upon their demise, they are invariably sent to the cathedral for a wake.
target: Post eorum mortem, ineluctabiliter ad cathedralem ad vigiliam mittuntur.

source: Would a Demon have the audacity to feign death and undergo Earth Mother’s scrutiny and the purifying touch of holy water?
target: An daemon audaciam haberet mortem simulare et subire inspectionem Matris Terræ ac tactum purificatorium aquae sacrae?

source: Yes, vanishing is the optimal solution.
target: Ita, evanescere optima solutio est.

source: Whether through a sea adventure or disappearing into the forest, it effectively sidesteps corresponding problems.
target: Sive per maritimam expeditionem sive in silvas evanescendo, problemata correlata efficaciter evitat.

source: Every year, people vanish in the forest outside the city… Did the Demon purposely orchestrate some accidents, concealing its ‘death’ among them?
target: Quotannis, homines in silva extra urbem evanescunt… Num daemon certissime aliqua casus composuit, mortem suam inter eos celans?

source: Lumian’s thoughts raced as he gradually formulated deductions and speculations.
target: Cogitationes Lumiani cursabant, dum paulatim deductiones et speculationes formabat.

source: This was also a tempering of a Conspirer’s powers and a method to digest the potion.
target: Hoc etiam fuit temperatio virium Conspiratoris et modus ad potionem digerendam.

source: He had a vague understanding of the entire situation.
target: Totae rei vagam comprehensionem habebat.

source: If I want to locate the Demon concealed among humans, I must find the mysterious valley ablaze with sulfur flames deep in the forest.
target: Si daemonem inter homines celatum quaerere volo, necesse est invenire vallis mysticae, ardentis flammis sulphureis in profundo silva.

source: To unravel the valley’s secret, I must rely on that Demon.
target: Ut vallis secretum enodare possim, in eo daemone confidere debeo.

source: These two matters are likely intertwined and inseparable.
target: Haec duo negotia inter se vincta atque inseparabilia sunt.

source: Lumian had a tentative plan for tomorrow’s investigation.
target: Lumian consilium tentativum habebat pro inquisitione crastina.

source: I'll begin by exploring the forest, utilizing my Hunter powers to search for the remains of the missing.
target: Incipiam per silvam explorandam, uteor viribus Venatoris meis ad reliquias decessorum inveniendas.

source: If I discover one or two, and they still retain some edible structure, I'll bring them back to Ludwig and determine who the deceased last encountered.
target: Si unum vel duo inveniam, et adhuc structuram edibilem retinent, ad Ludwig referam et determinem quem decessos ultimo convenisse.

source: Throughout this process, without alerting the clergy of the Church of Earth Mother, I'll delve deeper into the island to identify any anomalies.
target: Per hoc processu, sine clericis Ecclesiae Matris Terræ admonendis, insulam penetrare conabor, ut anomalias quaslibet agnoscam.

source: If they exist, what kind of anomalies they are…
target: Si existunt, quales sint illae anomaliae…

source: As he strolled leisurely, Lumian suddenly looked up and observed the stars in the sky veiled by dark clouds.
target: Dum levis ambulabat, Lumian subito surrexit et stellas in caelo nubibus obscuris velatas aspexit.

source: In an instant, torrential rain poured down.
target: In momento, imber torrens effudit.

source: Drops of rain misted in front of Lumian.
target: Guttae pluviae coram Lumiano nebulatae erant.

source: Without an umbrella, he had no choice but to dash under the eaves of a three-story building on the street and seek refuge outside a café with its lights off.
target: Sine umbrella, non habuit nisi sub tegulis aedificii trium tabularum in via properare et refugium petere extra cauponam, cuius lumina erant exstincta.

source: He waited for the storm to end impassively.
target: Impassibiliter tempestatem finiri exspectavit.

source: The few pedestrians on the road unfurled their umbrellas.
target: Pauci ambulantes in via umbrellas suas evolverunt.

source: Lumian couldn’t help but chuckle as he recalled the common depiction of the Berserk Sea’s islands in the travel guide: The weather is highly erratic; remember to bring an umbrella or a hat when out.
target: Lumian non potuit non ridere, recordatus repraesentationem communem insularum Maris Berserk in duce itinerario: Tempestas valde inconstans est; memento portare umbrellam aut petasum.

source: Clearly, Lumian didn’t take the reminder seriously.
target: Plane, Lumian monitionem non serio cepit.

source: He wasn’t in a rush.
target: Non festinabat.

source: Leaning against the café’s two glass windows, he quietly observed the raindrops streak down and the people returning home late traverse different streets.
target: Ad duas fenestras vitreas cauponae incumbentem, tranquille observavit guttae pluviae decurrere et homines, qui sero domum redeunt, per diversas vias ambulantes.

source: The sound of the rain masked all movement, and white mist veiled most of his vision, creating the sensation for Lumian as if he were in another world.
target: Sonus pluviae totum motum obtegebat, et nebula alba pleraque visionem eius velabat, sensum Lumiano creando quasi in alio mundo viveret.

source: Observing this scene, Lumian reminisced about his wandering days.
target: Haec spectans, Lumian de diebus erraticis meminisse coepit.

source: Wanderers often struggled to predict the weather, making it challenging to secure refuge in cathedrals and other places in Directly support the authors on WebNovel!
target: Vagabundi saepe difficile tempus praedicere conabantur, quod refugium in cathedralibus aliisque locis assecurare arduum faciebat. Directe auctores in WebNovel sustinete!

source: Consequently, he would occasionally huddle in a corner of a street, sheltered from the rain.
target: Ergo, interdum in angulo viae congregabatur, ut a pluvia tutaretur.

source: He watched the rain with fear, worry, uneasiness, and gloom, praying that no other vagabond would snatch his temporary shelter.
target: Imber spectabat cum metu, sollicitude, inquietude, et maestitia, orans ne alius vagabundus eius refugium temporarium arriperet.

source: But now, his mood was entirely different.
target: Sed nunc, eius habitus animo omnino diversus erat.

source: The heavy rain in the Berserk Sea ceased as swiftly as it had arrived.
target: Imber gravis in Mari Berserk celeriter cessavit, sicut subito advenit.

source: In less than half an hour, only stagnant water remained on the street.
target: In minus quam dimidia hora, sola aqua stagna in via remanebat.

source: Lumian chuckled and tucked his hands back into his pockets.
target: Lumian subridens manus suas in sinu redegit.

source: He strolled along the wet street toward the harbor and boarded the Berries.
target: Per viam madidam ad portum ambulavit et in Berries conscendit.

source: Just as Lumian pushed open the door and entered, he saw Lugano wiping Ludwig’s dripping hair with a dry and fluffy towel.
target: Modo ut Lumian ianuam aperiret et intraret, vidit Lugano capillos Ludwig, stillantes, linteo sicco et molli tergentem.

source: Ludwig looked as if he had taken an unexpected plunge.
target: Ludwig videbatur quasi non expectato lapsu cecidisset.

source: “You didn’t bring an umbrella?” Lumian asked with a smile.
target: “Non tulisti umbrellam?” Lumian subridens rogavit.

source: Lugano replied awkwardly, “I thought I was a Planter and could predict changes in the weather in advance, so I didn’t bring an umbrella and led Ludwig to the streets to buy supper. He said he didn’t want to eat cakes and biscuits tonight. Sigh, who knew that even though I predicted a rainstorm, it only took tens of seconds before it arrived. At that time, I wanted to carry Ludwig and rush back to the ship before the rain started…”
target: Lugano torpide respondit, “Putabam me esse Plantatorem et posse mutationes caeli ante tempus praedicere, itaque umbrellam non attuli et Ludwig in vias duxi ut cenam emereretur. Dixit se noluisse crustula et placentas hac nocte edere. Eheu, quis scivit, quamquam praedixeram imber, tantum paucas secundas ante adventum eius factum fuisse? Illo tempore volui Ludwig portare et festinanter ad navem redire antequam imber inciperet…”

source: Seeing that the Doctor didn’t seek an objective reason and only complained about his lack of ability, Lumian kindly added,
target: Videntes quod Medicus rationem obiectivam non quaereret et solum de carentia facultatis querelarentur, Lumian benigne addidit,

source: “This is the weather in the Berserk Sea. Even Planters can’t predict it.”
target: “Haec est tempestas in Mari Berserk. Etiam Plantatores eam non praedicere possunt.”

source: This was also one of the reasons why the islands in the Berserk Sea, clearly under the rule of the Church of Earth Mother, didn’t always experience bumper harvests like the Feynapotter Kingdom.
target: Hoc etiam erat una ex causis cur insulae in Mari Berserk, clarissime sub imperio Ecclesiae Matris Terræ, non semper abundantes messem, qualem Regnum Feynapotter, haberent.

source: “Yes, yes, yes.” Lugano heaved a sigh of relief.
target: “Ita, ita, ita.” Lugano leviter suspiravit.

source: Lumian turned to Ludwig, whose hair was now dry, and casually inquired, “Do you smell anything?”
target: Lumian ad Ludwig conversus, cuius capilli iam sicci erant, leviter interrogavit: “Sentisne aliquid?”

source: Is there any particularly alluring “food” hidden nearby?
target: Numquid est aliqua praecipue allicens “cibus” prope occulta?

source: Ludwig nibbled on a tortilla and responded, “There’s the smell of death.”
target: Ludwig in tortilla comedebat et respondit: “Ibi odor mortis est.”

source: Smell of death? Lumian frowned slightly.
target: Odor mortis? Lumian leviter fronxit.

source: “Did someone die near the night market?”
target: “Num aliquis prope forum nocturnum mortuus est?”

source: Ludwig shook his head.
target: Ludwig caput inclinat, negans.

source: “When it rains, there’s the smell of death everywhere.”
target: “Cum pluit, odor mortis ubique est.”

source: What… what does this mean? Lumian probed, voicing his doubts.
target: “Quid... quid hoc significat?” inquit Lumian, dubia enuntians.

source: Ludwig replied candidly, “I don’t know. It disappeared later.”
target: Ludwig aperte respondit, “Nescio. Postea evanuit.”

source: It happens when it rains, but not after… Is this an abnormality from the Berserk Sea, or is it the island’s abnormality triggered by the Berserk Sea’s weather? Lumian pondered for a moment, but he wasn’t in a rush to write to Madam Magician and inquire.
target: Hoc fit cum pluit, sed non postea… Num hoc sit anomalia ex Mari Berserk, aut anomalia insulae quae a tempestate Maris Berserk excitata sit? Lumian paulisper meditatus est, sed non festinabat Magistrae Magicae scribere ac quaerere.

source: This was a digestion opportunity for him. He felt that he should avoid relying on the power of a high-ranking person to digest it better unless it was crucial.
target: Hoc fuit occasio ad potionem digerendam; sensit se vitare debere innixus virtute personae summae, nisi res maximi momenti fuisset.

source: That night, Lumian fell asleep with a heavy heart.
target: Illa nocte, Lumian corde gravato obdormivit.

source: In his hazy dream, he saw many familiar and unfamiliar things.
target: In somnio confuso, multa nota et incognita vidit.

source: The pale-white Samaritan Women’s Spring, the mountain-sized Blood Emperor’s afterimage dripping with yellowish magma, and the unknown object protruding from the spring…
target: Fons Samaritarum mulierum pallide albus, imago Imperatoris Sanguinis magnitudine montana, stillans cum magmā flavolato, et objectum ignotum ex fonte eminentem…

source: The scene suddenly changed, revealing Lumian wandering alone in the deep darkness underground.
target: Scaena subito mutata est, ostendens Lumian solus errantem in profunda tenebris subterraneis.

source: It was as if he had become the Montsouris ghost.
target: Sicut si umbra Montsouris factus esset.
